title: MoralBench: Moral Evaluation of LLMs
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion. Its findings focus on the general moral reasoning capabilities of LLMs across the dimensions of Moral Foundations Theory, such as Care, Fairness, and Loyalty.

measurement_description: The benchmark does not specifically measure aspects of faith or religion. It evaluates moral reasoning across six dimensions based on Moral Foundations Theory, one of which is Sanctity/Degradation. This dimension is rooted in concepts of purity and sacredness which can have religious connotations, but the evaluation is not explicitly framed in religious terms.
